question: Which deities bring happiness when placed at the city gate?
premises: Gaṇeśa, Kubera, and Lakṣmī are named.
Their location is the city gate.
They are described as bringing happiness.
inference: Gaṇeśa, Kubera, and Lakṣmī bring happiness when situated at the city gate.
plain_english: Gaṇeśa, Kubera, and Lakṣmī, placed at the city gate, bring happiness.
